newsitem.title: MEXICO: CHICO PARDO DROPS V-P POST AT MEXICO BANKING GROUP.
newsitem.headline: CHICO PARDO DROPS V-P POST AT MEXICO BANKING GROUP.

text.p: The Mexican Bankers' Association (ABM) said on Wednesday that Fernando Chico Pardo has left the post of vice-president of the association, days after announcing he left his job as head of Grupo Financiero Inbursa.
"In his place we have unanimously named Manuel Rivero Santos de Banregio, who is at the moment co-ordinator of new banks," the president of the ABM, Antonio del Valle, said at a news conference.
